name: alt-text
description: Suggests alt text for images in your media library that have none, using a vision model you choose, and stages each one for your review.

provider.title: Vision provider
provider.description: Which service describes your images. It needs an API key of its own.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The key of the provider above. Stored here and never shown again.

model.title: Model
model.description: A model that reads images, for example gpt-4o-mini. Leave empty for the provider's small default.

language.title: Language of the alt text
language.description: A language name or code, for example en, de or Portuguese.

site_url.title: Address of this site
site_url.description: For example https://example.com. Used to turn /media paths into links the provider can open; not needed when your media links are already absolute.
